Google launched the Fitbit Air with AI health coach integration, adding personalized coaching capabilities to their wearable device ecosystem. While this targets individual consumers rather than gym management software, it represents the growing trend of AI-powered fitness coaching that could influence client expectations for personalized training experiences.
